999008199.text:
準備、完の了！
いつでもブラオールに行けるっすわ！

localizations.en: All set! We're ready to head to Braulle anytime!

999008199.text:
今回はまた随分と積荷が少ないのね。
本当にバーバラ号とアルビ号の２隻で大丈夫なの？

localizations.en: We're traveling unusually light this time. Are you sure just the Barbara and the Alvie will be enough?

999008199.text:
平気だよ。ブラオールまでの航路は安全だからね。
なんたって諸島同盟でも一番の大都市だし？　うん平気

localizations.en: We'll be fine. The route to Braulle is safe. After all, it's the biggest city in the Archipelago Federation, so yeah, totally safe.

999008199.text:
今のうちにフロッケ号の手入れができるって
ランツェさんも張り切ってたよ

localizations.en: Lanze was pretty excited about having time to work on the Flocke while we're there.

999008199.text:
ブラオール、噂に聞いた大都市……
アルビちゃん、ついに足を踏み入れます……！

localizations.en: Braulle, the great city I've only heard about in stories... I'm finally going to set foot there...!

999008199.text:
すっかりおのぼりさんだね、オノボリーナ。
神聖国の案内人ともあろうものが

localizations.en: You're quite the country bumpkin, aren't you, Bumpkina? And here I thought you were supposed to be a Guide.

999008199.text:
むっ……しょうがないでしょ、
初めてのブラオールなんだから。あとアルビーナな

localizations.en: Hey... can you blame me? It's my first time in Braulle. And it's Alvina.

999008199.text:
じゃあ、案内人の役割も僕に任せてもらおうかな？
何度か僕らは行ったことがあるしね

localizations.en: Well then, how about you let me handle the guide duties? We've been there a few times before.

999008199.text:
とはいえ、最後に行ったのはだいぶ昔のことだ。
景色もすっかり変わってるかもしれないよ

localizations.en: Though it's been quite a while since our last visit. The scenery might've changed completely by now.

999008199.text: あれ、そういえばリーベとゴゥは？

localizations.en: Wait, where are Liebe and Gou?

999008199.text:
あの子らは別件。危険生物の「管理」中だよ。
その分アタシらが同行させてもらうから

localizations.en: Those two are on a different assignment. They're managing some dangerous creatures. So we'll be tagging along instead.

999008199.text: 同行という指示は我が主から出ていない

localizations.en: I received no such directive from our master to accompany you.

999008199.text:
ヤドヴィガ、それにキューン！
また私たちを監視しているの？

localizations.en: Jadwiga, and Quinn! Are you monitoring us again?

999008199.text:
う、ううん。今回は違うの。
イェルカ姉貴とシトリンに用があって……

localizations.en: N-no, it's different this time. We actually have business with Jelka and Citrine...

999008199.text:
我が主からの命令。二人も私たちと共に
不穏分子の「管理」を進めよと……

localizations.en: Direct orders from our master. You two are to join us in managing destabilizing elements.

999008199.text: アウグスト直々の招集ってことかい……

localizations.en: A personal summons from August himself...

999008199.text:
不穏分子って……ゴゥさんたちがしてる危険生物の
「管理」を手伝うって意味じゃ、ないですよね

localizations.en: Destabilizing elements... You don't mean helping Gou manage dangerous creatures, do you?

999008199.text:
肯定。私たちの分担は危険思想を抱く人類、
たとえば元極夜の錬金党のクリセルダなど

localizations.en: Affirmative. Our assignment concerns humans with dangerous ideologies. Such as Criselda, former leader of the Polar Night Alchemists.

999008199.text: そんな！　まだクリセルダさんのことを……！

だね。それを聞かされちゃあ
仕事をさせるわけにはいかないよ！

localizations.en: No way! If that's what you're planning, we can't let you go through with it!

999008199.text:
クリセルダも最近は大人しくしていると聞くよ。
そんな急に話を進めることはないと思うけどね

localizations.en: I hear Criselda's been keeping a low profile lately. There's no need to rush into anything.

999008199.text: そ、それは……事情が

私からすれば我が主の命令に従わない姉上が
同じ兄弟として理解できない

localizations.en: I cannot comprehend why my siblings refuse to follow our master's orders. As fellow creations, this defies understanding.

999008199.text:
こういう「管理」は粋じゃないんだよ。
彼女をどう裁くかは同じ人間に委ねるべきさ！

localizations.en: This kind of management isn't chic at all. How she's judged should be left to other humans!

999008199.text:
不測の事態が起こった際には、
実力行使の許可も出ている

localizations.en: In the event of resistance, authorization for forceful measures has been granted.

999008199.text:
ちょ、ちょっとヤド姉！
本当に兄弟で戦っちゃうの？

localizations.en: W-wait, Jadwiga! Are we really going to fight our own siblings?!

999008199.text: キューン、下がって
あなたがたであれば、私一人で十分と判断

localizations.en: Assessment: I alone am sufficient to handle the two of you.

999008199.text:
ふぅん……言ったね妹め！　やってみるがいいさ！
やれるものならねッ！！

localizations.en: Oh really now, little sister?! Go ahead and try it then! If you think you can!!
